name: com.cev-os/data
title: CEV-OS Data API
description: Free keyless REST+MCP, 26 tools: US macro, earnings, TRIPWIRE, regime, cams

tools.name: get_macro_calendar
tools.description: Use this when you need official US release times (CPI, PPI, payrolls, GDP, PCE, retail sales, JOLTS, trade balance, productivity, claims, FOMC, ISM dates) with actual and prior values once released. Free. License: cleared. Attribution required: Sources: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (incl. BLS Public Data API), U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis, U.S. Census Bureau, U.S. Department of Labor, Federal Reserve Board. This service uses BEA data but is not endorsed or certified by BEA. BLS.gov cannot vouch for the data or analyses derived from these data after the data have been retrieved from BLS.gov.

from.description: Start date (ET), YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today minus 30 days.

to.description: End date (ET), YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today plus 60 days.

event.description: Comma-separated event types: cpi, ppi, employment_situation, jolts, eci, gdp, pce, retail_sales, jobless_claims, fomc_decision, fomc_minutes, ism_manufacturing, ism_services, trade_balance, productivity

tools.name: get_catalysts
tools.description: Use this when you need to know whether the next hours contain a scheduled high-impact event: US macro releases, FOMC, Treasury auctions, SEC-filed or estimated earnings, and options expiry, each with an impact tier. Free. License: cleared. Attribution required: Sources: BLS, BEA, U.S. Census Bureau, DOL, Federal Reserve Board, U.S. Treasury (TreasuryDirect), SEC EDGAR. This service uses BEA data but is not endorsed or certified by BEA.

kinds.description: Comma-separated filter: macro, fed, treasury_auction, earnings, options_expiry.

include_estimated.description: Include estimated (not yet SEC-confirmed) earnings dates (default true).

tools.name: get_release_status
tools.description: Use this when you need to know whether a scheduled US release (CPI, PPI, payrolls, JOLTS, GDP, PCE, FOMC, retail sales, claims) or an S&P 100/NASDAQ-100 earnings 8-K is out, when it was first seen, and actual vs prior vs revision. Free. License: cleared. Attribution required: Sources: BLS, BEA, U.S. Census Bureau, DOL, Federal Reserve Board, SEC EDGAR. Detection timestamps measured by cev-os. This service uses BEA data but is not endorsed or certified by BEA.

event.description: Comma-separated event types: cpi, ppi, employment_situation, jolts, eci, gdp, pce, retail_sales, jobless_claims, fomc_decision, fomc_minutes, ism_manufacturing, ism_services, trade_balance, productivity

from.description: Start date (ET) YYYY-MM-DD, default 7 days ago.

to.description: End date (ET) YYYY-MM-DD, default 2 days ahead.

ticker.description: S&P 100 / NASDAQ-100 ticker: adds its latest 8-K Item 2.02 (earnings) acceptance time.

tools.name: get_macro_regime
tools.description: Use this when you want one slow-moving macro regime flag (risk_on / neutral / risk_off) with its transparent inputs: yield curve, financial conditions, financial stress, unemployment trigger and jobless-claims trend. Free. License: cleared_with_attribution. Attribution required: Federal Reserve Board (H.15), Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago (NFCI), Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (STLFSI4), U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (UNRATE), U.S. Department of Labor (ICSA); retrieved from FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.

tools.name: get_incident_assets
tools.description: Use this when you need recent geopolitical, conflict and natural-hazard incidents mapped to the asset classes and liquid proxies they are tagged against (oil, grains, gas, semis, gold, Treasuries, country ETFs). Free. License: cleared_with_attribution. Attribution required: The GDELT Project (https://www.gdeltproject.org/); Uppsala Conflict Data Program (UCDP), CC BY 4.0; U.S. Geological Survey; GDACS (EC-JRC / UN OCHA), not for life-safety use. Asset tagging by cev-os TRIPWIRE.

since_hours.description: Incidents updated in the last N hours (1-168, default 24).

asset.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on asset tags, e.g. oil, semiconductors, gold.

tools.name: get_iss_orbit
tools.description: Use this when you need the International Space Station's current orbital elements (CelesTrak OMM: epoch, inclination, mean motion, eccentricity...), altitude and orbital period to propagate its position yourself with SGP4. Free. License: cleared_with_attribution. Attribution required: Orbital data: CelesTrak (https://celestrak.org/). Fallback: wheretheiss.at (CC BY 4.0). Via cev-os TRIPWIRE.

tools.name: get_news_video
tools.description: Use this when you need links to official live news video (YouTube embed URL, broadcaster's official page) for a country or for international wires, as curated for the TRIPWIRE map. Free. License: cleared_with_attribution. Attribution required: Curated by cev-os TRIPWIRE. Streams are the broadcasters' own, played by YouTube / the broadcaster under their terms.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, or INTL for pan-national channels.

embed_only.description: Only channels with at least one embed candidate (default false).

tools.name: get_inform_severity
tools.description: Use this when you need the monthly INFORM humanitarian crisis severity (1-5) for a country or the current list of scored crises. Free. License: cleared_with_attribution. Attribution required: INFORM Severity Index (EU JRC / ACAPS / OCHA), CC BY 4.0. Tripwire maps published country scores to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; scores are unchanged. https://drmkc.jrc.ec.europa.eu/inform-index/INFORM-Severity

tools.name: get_country_risk
tools.description: Use this when you need a transparent heuristic country-risk score (list or one ISO2 country) with advisory level, recent incident counts and the weighted components — not an official rating. Free. License: cleared_with_attribution. Attribution required: Heuristic country-risk score by cev-os TRIPWIRE; not an official rating. Inputs: The GDELT Project; UCDP (CC BY 4.0); USGS; GDACS (EC-JRC / UN OCHA), not for life-safety use; US Department of State; Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0 (FCDO); CDC Travelers' Health (no CDC endorsement).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2: return that country's profile instead of the ranked list.

tools.name: get_threat_level
tools.description: Use this when you need TRIPWIRE's single global 5-to-1 threat-level heuristic (calm to critical) with every component and reason — not official DEFCON. Free. License: cleared_with_attribution. Attribution required: Tripwire threat level, not official DEFCON. A heuristic composite of open, commercial-safe feeds. Inputs: GDELT; UCDP (CC BY 4.0); GDACS (not for life-safety use); NOAA NTWC/PTWC and SWPC; CISA KEV (CC0; no CISA logo or endorsement); US Department of State; UK FCDO (Open Government Licence v3.0); CDC (no endorsement).

tools.name: get_travel_advisories
tools.description: Use this when you need the current US State Department and UK FCDO travel-advisory level for a country, or the list of countries at or above a level. Free. License: cleared_with_attribution. Attribution required: US Department of State (travel.state.gov). Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0 (FCDO, https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice).

tools.name: get_cyber_threats
tools.description: Use this when you need recent CISA KEV entries (with EPSS/NVD enrichment), CISA advisories, and GDELT cyber-article links, optionally filtered by country. Free. License: cleared_with_attribution. Attribution required: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog (CC0 1.0). No CISA logo or endorsement. CISA cybersecurity advisories (US Government work). No CISA logo or endorsement. EPSS scores: FIRST.org (https://www.first.org/epss/). CVSS enrichment: NIST National Vulnerability Database. The GDELT Project (https://www.gdeltproject.org/); citation required.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2: keep CISA advisories and GDELT articles that name that country. KEV is global.

tools.name: get_hazard_alerts
tools.description: Use this when you need current natural-hazard alerts coarsened to country or NAVAREA region: GDACS, NOAA tsunami, NGA maritime warnings and USGS earthquakes. Free. License: cleared_with_attribution. Attribution required: GDACS, Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System, EC-JRC / UN OCHA (https://www.gdacs.org/). GDACS alerts are automatic estimates. Not for life-safety use; follow official national authorities. NOAA / NWS Tsunami Warning Centers (https://www.tsunami.gov/). NGA Maritime Safety Information (https://msi.nga.mil/). Not for navigation. U.S. Geological Survey (https://earthquake.usgs.gov/); credit requested.

region.description: Case-insensitive substring on NAVAREA / tsunami center / country name, e.g. NAVAREA IV.

tools.name: get_space_weather
tools.description: Use this when you need NOAA SWPC geomagnetic (G), radio-blackout (R) and solar-radiation (S) scales for the last 72 hours plus recent alerts. Free. License: cleared. Attribution required: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center (https://www.swpc.noaa.gov/).

tools.name: get_outbreaks
tools.description: Use this when you need current CDC travel health notices (levels 1-4) for a country or the full list. Free. License: cleared. Attribution required: CDC Travelers' Health, Travel Health Notices (https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices). No CDC endorsement implied.

tools.name: get_severe_weather
tools.description: Use this when you need current US severe-weather alerts (NWS, including a lat/lon point filter), tropical storms, rivers in flood and FAA TFRs. Free. License: cleared. Attribution required: NOAA / National Weather Service (https://www.weather.gov/). NOAA / National Hurricane Center (https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/). NOAA National Water Prediction Service (https://water.noaa.gov/). FAA TFR list (https://tfr.faa.gov/). Not for navigation or flight planning.

lat.description: Optional WGS84 latitude for NWS point alerts (requires lon).

lon.description: Optional WGS84 longitude for NWS point alerts (requires lat).

state.description: Two-letter USPS state filter (also matches NWS zone text).

tools.name: get_natural_events
tools.description: Use this when you need NASA EONET open natural events (Smithsonian/SIVolcano sources dropped) plus NASA FIRMS fire-detection counts per country per day. Free. License: cleared_with_attribution. Attribution required: NASA Earth Observatory Natural Event Tracker (https://eonet.gsfc.nasa.gov/). Cite NASA. NASA FIRMS (https://earthdata.nasa.gov/firms), part of NASA LANCE / ESDIS. Cite NASA. Events sourced from the Smithsonian Institution / SIVolcano are omitted (non-commercial terms).

tools.name: get_satellite_elements
tools.description: Use this when you need CelesTrak GP orbital elements (OMM) for a TRIPWIRE-cached group (stations, weather, resource, gps-ops, starlink) to propagate yourself with SGP4. Free. License: cleared_with_attribution. Attribution required: Orbital data: CelesTrak (https://celestrak.org/). Via cev-os TRIPWIRE cache (never fetched from CelesTrak per caller).

group.description: CelesTrak GP group already cached by TRIPWIRE.

tools.name: get_traffic_cameras
tools.description: Use this when you need public traffic-camera locations and still/stream links from agency catalogs (TfL, Austin, Caltrans, TxDOT, DriveBC, Calgary, Toronto, Norway, Finland, NSW, WSDOT, King County, Catalonia, Hong Kong, DelDOT, Ontario 511). Links and metadata only; never proxied. Free. License: cleared_with_attribution. Attribution required: Traffic camera locations via CEV-OS TRIPWIRE / CEV-DataHub. Agency attribution in data.sources[].attribution. Links and metadata only; CEV-OS never proxies or stores camera images or video. Not for navigation.

source.description: Camera catalog id (e.g. txdot_cctv, tfl_jamcam). Omit to sample across all API sources up to limit.

tools.name: get_worldcams
tools.description: Use this when you need WorldCams public webcam directory locations and page/YouTube links (~758). Own TRIPWIRE layer. Links only; never proxied. Free. License: cleared_with_attribution. Attribution required: Camera locations and page links from worldcams.tv. Individual webcam rights belong to their owners. CEV-OS never proxies or stores webcam video or images.

tools.name: get_satellite_imagery
tools.description: Use this when you need a metadata catalog for NASA GIBS VIIRS/HLS and NOAA nowCOAST GOES/global IR browser tile layers: layer id, tile URL templates, latest available date, licence and credit. No proxied imagery. Free. License: cleared. Attribution required: We acknowledge the use of imagery provided by services from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), part of NASA's Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS). GOES/global infrared: NOAA nowCOAST (NESDIS GOES and global satellite partners). CEV-OS serves catalog metadata only; clients fetch tiles directly from NASA/NOAA.

tools.name: get_adsb
tools.description: Use this when you need nearby live aircraft positions with LADD/PIA/TIS-B hex dropped and registration/owner/operator stripped. Free. License: cleared_with_attribution. Attribution required: Aircraft positions: adsb.lol (https://api.adsb.lol/), OpenStreetMap ODbL 1.0. https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright

lat.description: WGS84 latitude of the search centre (required).

lon.description: WGS84 longitude of the search centre (required).

dist.description: Radius in nautical miles (10–250, default 50; rounded to 10 NM cache buckets).

tools.name: get_places
tools.description: Use this when you need nearby OSM points of interest (water, springs, shelters, peaks, hospitals, pharmacies, fuel, fire, police). Free. License: cleared_with_attribution. Attribution required: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL 1.0), via the Overpass API. https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright

lat.description: WGS84 latitude of the search centre (required).

lon.description: WGS84 longitude of the search centre (required).

tools.name: get_air_quality
tools.description: Use this when you need CAMS air-quality (US AQI, PM2.5, ozone) for a lat/lon. Returns 503 until a paid Open-Meteo plan is enabled. Free. License: cleared_with_attribution. Attribution required: CAMS / Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service via Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0). https://open-meteo.com/

tools.name: get_wildfires
tools.description: Use this when you need current US wildfire incident points from NIFC/IRWIN WFIGS (name, acres, containment, lat/lon). Free. License: cleared. Attribution required: National Interagency Fire Center / IRWIN WFIGS current incident locations (https://data-nifc.opendata.arcgis.com/). US Government work.

tools.name: get_earthquakes
tools.description: Use this when you need recent USGS earthquakes with magnitude, place, time and coordinates. Free. License: cleared. Attribution required: U.S. Geological Survey earthquakes (https://earthquake.usgs.gov/). Credit requested.
